title: A lane's push to its own branch is refused while that branch is in an open, ready integration PR
why: Lane push-head-upstream-name ([ended:lane:-push-head-upstream-name]), 05:12-05:25 CST Nov 9: it pushed main merges to #2199 and #2327 (heads 39432db98, 63d71001a) while runner 8's batch 68 (#2426), built from their earlier heads, was running CI. A lane in a running batch holds its head, but no check stopped the push. Harm: the batch confirm sees a moved head, and work is redone.
note: #2378 (step batch-freeze-lane-set-enforce) does not refuse it: it only detects a moved head at the next `--batch-build`, and nothing in guard.py, guard_push_delete.py or guard_merge.py refuses it (coordinator, 05:47 CST Nov 9, from #2378's lane). The lane proposed lane-head-holds-in-batch, an ask or a read of open batch PRs before a push; the coordinator chose a refusal. It touches the push guard, so it starts after batch 68 merges. Filed 05:48 CST Nov 9. Batch 68 merged (#2449, 11:55 CST Nov 9): free to start. Lane [ended:Lane-lane-push-frozen-in-batch] started 12:13 CST Nov 9 (coordinator). Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was [ended:Lane-lane-push-frozen-in-batch]). Coordinator pick 13:37 CST Nov 12 (stands item): ready, merge-flow express, first in the next list; a fresh lane rebuilds #2463 (3-day-old draft, 15 commits, conflicting with main) on current main. Lane started 13:49 CST Nov 12 (express R55): rebuilds #2463 fresh on main. Coordinator 16:09 CST Nov 12 (carry-over from archived lane batch-push-refused-in-run): #2463 refuses lane pushes to a ready batch but skips draft batches; the rebuild should cover draft batches too, or record why not.
